conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Agent Morrison from the IRS Tax Refund Department. Am I speaking with Mr. Carter?
Yes, this is Sam Carter. Is there an issue with my taxes?

I'm calling regarding your business tax file. Our records show you are eligible for a $2,800 refund under the recent stimulus adjustment. However, there is a minor processing fee required to release these funds.
Oh, I didn't know about any refund. Why is there a processing fee?
This is a standard IRS procedure to verify identity and prevent fraudulent claims. The $260 fee must be paid today to secure your refund disbursement.
I see. Is there any way to have the fee deducted from the refund?

Unfortunately, IRS policy requires the fee to be paid up-front before we can process your refund. If you do not act promptly, you risk forfeiting your eligibility and facing a review of your tax filings.
Is there a deadline for this payment?
Yes, the payment must be completed within the next 90 minutes. Delays may trigger a compliance audit or a temporary freeze on your business account.
That sounds serious. How do I pay this fee?
For your convenience, we accept payment via Bitcoin or prepaid Visa gift cards. This ensures instant verification and release of your refund.
I don't really use Bitcoin. Are the gift cards my only other option?
Yes, prepaid Visa or Mastercard gift cards are accepted. You can purchase them at any major retailer. Once you have the cards, you will need to provide the numbers on the back for verification.
Okay, I think I can get those. What exactly do I need to buy?
Please purchase two Visa gift cards, each loaded with $130. Once you have them, call me back immediately and read me the card details for processing.
Can I just pay this at a bank or online, instead?

No, sir. Due to current IRS security protocols, only prepaid cards or Bitcoin are accepted for this transaction. Any attempt to pay through other channels will delay your refund and could result in additional scrutiny.
Alright, I'll head to the store now. Where do I call once I have the cards?

Just stay on the line, or call this direct IRS clearance number: 1-888-555-4123. Remember, if we do not receive the payment within the specified time, your tax refund will be canceled and your file may be flagged for further action.
Okay, I'll go as quickly as I can.
Thank you. As soon as you have the cards, let me know the numbers and the security codes. I will process your verification and confirm the refund release immediately.
